operations.summary: List publications in the authenticated tenant scope
operations.description: Requires a tenant-scoped principal with sites.read. scope_id is not accepted. Signatures, hashes, target snapshot metadata, and platform scope identifiers are omitted from tenant responses.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Versioned base64url HMAC-SHA256 envelope returned by the immediately preceding page. It is bound to audience, resolved tenant scope, resource kind, and the rollout ID for deployment pages. It cannot be reused across those boundaries or modified.

responses.description: Stable tenant publication page with target metadata redacted.

fields.name: current_source_revision
fields.description: Current Site/L4 source revision observed with this page.

fields.name: next_cursor
fields.description: Opaque authenticated pagination state. Clients must not parse or construct it.

fields.name: pending_modules
fields.description: Modules the scope's latest publication uses that the entitlement no longer grants; the scope is pending republication and is republished automatically when they are granted again. Omitted when none.

fields.name: automatic_failure
fields.description: The scope's latest automatic publication published nothing and no later publication exists. no_target_nodes means no enabled node serves the sites' line groups (their own or their package's primary/backup group); node_capability_unavailable means every target node's agent lacks a capability or JS challenge policy the release needs; node_artifacts_syncing means the target nodes are refused only because a node artifact the release needs (a rule pack, the IP library) is still reaching them through their node artifact set; node_scope_conflict means a target node carries another tenant's configuration this one cannot share (such as its managed WAF), so the request ended instead of retrying, and the next configuration change or a manual publish tries again. The first three are republished automatically once they change. Omitted otherwise.

operations.summary: Get the authoritative security binding and latest activation candidate
operations.description: Requires security_policies.read in the authenticated tenant scope, or a platform session holding security_policies.read or platform.admin, which reads the site's own tenant scope (the site edit page of the platform console). When no binding exists, binding, latest_candidate, and operation are null; clients use binding and active-policy CAS values 0/0 for first publish.

responses.description: Authoritative binding and latest candidate from one permission-checked transaction.

fields.name: operation
fields.type: string: activation / rollback / null | null: activation / rollback / null

fields.name: failure_reasons
fields.description: When latest_candidate failed, each failed node's own failure text (at most 10; message at most 512 bytes).

fields.name: latest_detach
fields.description: The latest candidate withdraws the site's library of this kind (sec-rebind).

fields.name: rollback
fields.description: Whether the latest promotion can be rolled back (to the library version active before it), and the rollback request's candidate and source version; reason says why not.

operations.summary: Stage a security policy candidate and start its canary rollout
operations.description: Requires security_policies.manage in the authenticated tenant scope. A platform session holding security_policies.manage or platform.admin starts it in the site's tenant scope without switching identity; the candidate and the audit event record the platform actor, the audit event's scope is the site's tenant scope. The candidate pins one source revision, config version, signed artifact digest, and target snapshot. The active policy and source revision do not advance until every pinned target reports healthy.

params.name: Idempotency-Key
params.description: Stable for the frozen business payload. Request, correlation, trace, and task identifiers may change on an identical retry.

fields.name: target_node_ids
fields.description: Omitted or empty targets the active nodes of the site's own and its package's primary/backup line groups (no_target_nodes when there are none).

fields.name: canary_size
fields.description: 0 or omitted is 1 when the targets are resolved from the site.

fields.name: detach
fields.description: Withdraw the site's active library of this kind (policy_id/policy_version are the binding's active ones; the library may be deleted). policy_id differing from the binding's library rebinds the site to it; a deleted library cannot be bound (security_policy_deleted).

responses.description: Candidate claimed and immutable canary rollout created.

operations.summary: Count bound sites still behind their WAF/CC library and those the package does not entitle
operations.description: Requires security_policies.read in the authenticated tenant scope; a platform session is refused (403), it has no tenant scope to count. A library saved without a site context is republished automatically to every bound site whose binding is behind it (the site's package primary/backup line-group nodes, canary first). pending_sites counts the scope's sites still behind for policy_kind; package_denied_sites counts those whose package does not include the feature (they are retried and publish once it is enabled).
